name: Whole Green Moong Curry
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) whole green moong, soaked 4 hours
½ tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Pressure-cook the moong with 1½ cups water for 3 whistles, or simmer for 30 minutes, until soft.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, ginger, garlic and chilli for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes until pulpy.
Add the moong with its liquid and simmer for 8 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.
note: Whole moong keeps its skin, so it carries more fibre than split moong.
